region_scene_page.compact: From Sabbath's dark heaviness to Priest and Maiden's sharpened attack, this road gives metal its central grammar.
region_scene_page.standard: From Sabbath's dark heaviness to Priest and Maiden's sharpened attack, this road gives metal its central grammar. Diamond Head's Am I Evil?, Accept's Balls to the Wall, Black Sabbath's Iron Man, and Motorhead's Ace of Spades give the scene its high-recognition landmarks.
region_scene_page.deep: From Sabbath's dark heaviness to Priest and Maiden's sharpened attack, this road gives metal its central grammar. The focus is not just loud rock; it is riff architecture, theatrical force, and a metal-specific identity. Diamond Head's Am I Evil?, Accept's Balls to the Wall, Black Sabbath's Iron Man, and Motorhead's Ace of Spades give the scene its high-recognition landmarks. From there, the examples move from quick recognition toward medium and deeper scene signals.
